headline: Dead Lands And Island Outposts See Renewed Base Contests
war_summary: Fresh base contests have erupted across the Dead Lands around Callahan's Boot and Callahan's Passage at The Latch, accompanied by a sharp casualty surge along the central corridor. Meanwhile, island warfare persists in Fishermans Row and Godcrofts with repeated outpost transfers logging in the latest two-hour interval, while Stlican Shelf and Marban Hollow also registered fresh captures at Vulpine Watch and Mox. Clashes in the Weathered Expanse remain fierce following extensive churn around Necropolis and Spirit Watch, though the rate of base turnovers has moderated from previous peaks. In contrast, earlier breakthroughs in Farranac Coast and Stonecradle have settled into heavy attritional slugging without recent property flips, while Lykos Isle, Oarbreaker, and King's Cage remain subdued. Deep fighting across Linn of Mercy and Loch Mor continues to extract a steady toll in men, yet both sectors maintain stable frontlines without strategic change.
